history.text: The American Colonization Society settled freed African Americans at Cape Mesurado.
Liberia declared independence, becoming Africa's first modern republic.
Samuel Doe's coup ended long rule by the settler-descended elite.
Two civil wars devastated the country.
Ellen Johnson Sirleaf became Africa's first elected woman head of state.

worthSeeing.title: Sapo National Park:
worthSeeing.text: The country's largest rainforest reserve, home to pygmy hippos.

worthSeeing.title: Providence Island:
worthSeeing.text: The Monrovia landing site of the first settlers in 1822.

worthSeeing.title: Robertsport:
worthSeeing.text: Atlantic surf beaches and fishing villages on Cape Mount.
